config.checkpoint_selection: Export after exactly 240/480 completed optimizer updates; finish training and exit before loading validation models. Select on 32 full validation tasks: zero available-exchange return errors, minimum success rate across available exchanges/fallback/handoff, overall success, fewer repeated-field attempts, then lower validation loss. No test inference before selection.
config.runtime_policy: Previous adapter old vs new flow separates engineering; previous vs new adapter under the identical v4 flow measures the bundled training recipe. Base + v4 is a quality comparator. All arms use greedy unconstrained generation and eight total model calls.
config.promotion_rule: V4 overall, exchange completion, fallback and handoff success must each be at least both new-flow comparators; repeated field attempts lower than previous_new_flow; zero available-exchange return attempts; all confirmation invariants. No claim of production readiness.

dataset.scope: Fresh synthetic six-character entities and split-specific phrasing. 16 shared families; within-split counterfactual worlds intentionally shared. Full clean trajectories, one extra handoff/exchange terminal, and targeted recovery labels; erroneous actions never supervised. Old tests are development evidence; new tests never select weights.

initialization: Pinned base; no previous or preflight adapter reused

protocol.method: Action-name-span preference plus mean chosen-completion NLL
protocol.selection: Fixed 136-update final checkpoint; complete business validation is diagnostic.
protocol.revision_reason: Unregularized sequence preference regressed on validation. Contrast exact action-name tokens to remove negative-reason wording shortcuts; anchor all chosen completion tokens with NLL. Restart from SFT480, never the failed preference adapter. No new test inference before revision.
protocol.scope: Original 124 train-only pairs plus 12 genuine-return contrasts from original training worlds. Preference uses exact action-name token masks; NLL covers every chosen completion/end-of-turn token. Prompt and padding masked. Tail projection omits only zero-loss positions, audited without truncating context or targets.

preference.execution: Compiled gradient with mutable input/output state capture; masked 32-token padding. Wired memory capped at 6 GiB, cache at 256 MiB, cleared after each pair. SFT480 initialization; failed unregularized preference weights not reused.

validation_candidates.selection: Fixed final checkpoint; diagnostic validation only.
Fixed final checkpoint; diagnostic business validation only.

protocol.method: Recovery-state action-span preference plus chosen-completion NLL
protocol.selection: Fixed 80-update recovery checkpoint before any new test inference.
protocol.scope: Original training worlds only. New states omit missing answers even after real order/catalog reads. No validation/test examples enter training. New facts are arithmetic over actual completed tool results for all candidates, never selected answers or intent routing.

recovery.execution: Compiled gradient with mutable input/output state capture; masked 32-token padding. Wired memory capped at 6 GiB, cache at 256 MiB, cleared after each pair. Action136 initialization; no failed unregularized or preflight weights reused.

protocol.method: Balanced conditional action/payment-span preference plus chosen NLL
protocol.selection: Validation-only compare recovery696 vs calibration744. Preserve exchange/H/clarification/return/overall counts and question repeats, zero exchange-as-return; then prefer fallback, overall, fewer questions/calls. Frozen choice helper defines exact rule.
protocol.scope: Training worlds only; stock/return permission counterfactuals share worlds. Eight return, eight exchange and eight handoff labels. Same-tool gift-card contrasts use only payment-value tokens as reward, never identical action tokens. Two repetitions of one seeded shuffled 24-pair order; no new independent tasks claimed.

calibration.execution: Compiled gradient with mutable input/output state capture; masked 32-token padding. Wired memory capped at 6 GiB, cache at 256 MiB, cleared after each pair. Recovery80 initialization; no preflight weights reused.
